key_insight: VISTA Architect precomputes a provenance-linked clinical knowledge graph and timeline so LLMs can answer patient-history questions more accurately and efficiently than repeated raw-text prompting or RAG.
clinical_relevance: This could help multidisciplinary tumor boards rapidly reconstruct complex longitudinal EHR histories while preserving traceability back to source documentation.
method: Transforms ingested EHRs into a source-faithful MEDS Graph with full provenance.
Builds a higher-level Timeline Object Architecture (TOA) using graph-guided LLM extraction to deduplicate and order key events.
Supports downstream queries over an organized patient state, with source lookup only when verification is needed.
evidence_signal: In 1,180 thoracic oncology patients, the system reached 96.4% accuracy (mean 9.75/10) across 15 tumor-board-salient variables over 17,700 evaluations.
watch_item: The system was validated in thoracic oncology, so broader performance and workflow fit in other specialties still need testing.
paper_title: VISTA Architect: A graph database-oriented health AI system demonstrated in multidisciplinary tumor boards
